source_caption:
🎬: I Love Boosters 

A group of rebellious women known as the Boosters make a living stealing luxury goods from wealthy stores and reselling them. Their latest target is a ruthless fashion mogul whose business empire is built on exploiting people and turning everything into a status symbol.

When the Boosters decide to take on the fashion industry itself, their heists become bigger and more personal. What begins as a series of robberies turns into a chaotic fight against wealth, greed, and a system they believe deserves to be disrupted.

source_details.title: I Love Boosters
source_details.synopsis: I Love Boosters is a 2026 American absurdist crime comedy film written and directed by Boots Riley. Following the adventures of a group of shoplifters, it features an ensemble cast that includes Keke Palmer, Naomi Ackie, Taylour Paige, Poppy Liu, Eiza González, LaKeith Stanfield, Will Poulter, Don Cheadle, and Demi Moore. The film premiered at the 2026 South by Southwest Film & TV Festival on March 12, 2026, and was released theatrically in the United States by Neon on May 22. It received positive reviews from critics.
